step_direction: current becomes at least threshold A more negative; post current -200 to -5 A, pre current <0.5 A
balancing_exclusion: exclude if any I_CNV_Cell_1..8 magnitude >0.05 A at either adjacent sample
temporal_thinning: for each system and each threshold retain the earliest qualifying step in each UTC 3h bin; causal selection, no future target values
cell_response: R_step = (V_after-V_before)/(I_after-I_before) in ohm, multiplied by 1000; not pure instantaneous ohmic R due 5s median logging
SOC_limit: BMS SOC is an operating-point covariate, not capacity truth
source_bias: 28 returned-for-warranty 8S packs, active balancing and gaps; cannot train official 4S capacity from this proxy
